plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Chemistry BS graduation plan text PDF — 'Graduation Plan - Even Year Start' variant (the same PDF also publishes a 'Graduation Plan - Odd Year Start' variant, transcribed as a separate seed). Semester totals as printed: 17 / 15 / 15 / 17 / 13 / 14 / 16 / 13 = 120, matching the printed 'Total Hours 120'. Lecture+lab pairs printed on combined rows are modeled as single combined entries per the source's own hour groupings. Course titles verified against the official catalog: CHEM 1210 Principles of Chemistry I (PS); CHEM 1220 Principles of Chemistry II; CHEM 2310 Organic Chemistry I; CHEM 2320 Organic Chemistry II; CHEM 2600 Laboratory Safety and Practices; CHEM 2990R Chemistry Seminar and Professional Development; CHEM 3000 Quantitative Chemical Analysis; CHEM 3060 Physical Chemistry 1; CHEM 3070 Physical Chemistry II; CHEM 3100 Inorganic Chemistry; CHEM 3300 Instrumental Analysis; CHEM 3510 Biochemistry I; CHEM 3520 Biochemistry II; CHEM 4100 Advanced Inorganic Chemistry; CHEM 4800R Independent Research; CHEM 4910 Chemistry Senior Seminar; BIOL 1610 Principles of Biology I (LS); PHYS 2210 Physics/Scientists Engineers I (PS); PHYS 2220 Physics/Scientists Engineers II; MATH 1210 Calculus I (MA); MATH 1220 Calculus II (MA); MATH 2210 Multivariable Calculus (MA); ENGL 1010 Introduction to Writing (EN); ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN); SSC 1010 Trailblazer Connections. The 'MATH 2210' row carries the plan footnote 'or MATH 2250 or MATH 2270 or MATH 2280 or MATH 3060' and is modeled as a choice. 'CHEM Elective' slots (numbered 1-3) are choice placeholders; see the 2025-2026 catalog for the approved Chemistry Elective list. CHEM 4800R appears in two semesters (1 credit each), consistent with the program's minimum-2-credit Independent Research requirement. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
